openings.claim: A removable guide pocket with swingable keeper may replace screw-preload friction retention: bend/drill supplied strips into boundaries contacting unmarked regions, bolt through existing slots, pivot a strip against lift, and bound free play without squeezing; inspection access may remain.
openings.discriminator: Against the incumbent friction clamp, capture should keep the spare within 1 mm at negligible plate preload if boundaries resist stroke loads and keeper stays closed. Incidental friction may also let the rival pass; both passing without differing contact/slip behavior is inconclusive. Gloved removal/return within sixty seconds remains unestablished.
openings.probe: Preflight M4 slot compatibility, support, clearance, keeper travel and accessible unmarked handling regions; reject impossible geometry. Sequentially build clamp and pocket with the same supplied parts: four 80 mm strips, six M4 bolts/nuts, two magnets, four cork pads, 0.5 m wire; drill strips only. Within eighty fabrication minutes, allow at most two configurations. Initially one twenty-stroke run and timed removal/return check each; maximum three each/configuration within twenty observation minutes. Final run uses spare; its removal uses thick gloves. Mark references; measure displacement with ruler, time with stopwatch, count strokes; record boundary contact and keeper opening at negligible capture preload.
openings.uncertainty: M4 compatibility and placement without carriage modification, strip stiffness/bending accuracy, attachment stability below 1 mm, and captive keeper closure under unspecified loads/gloved release are assumptions. Defeat: excessive play, deflection, keeper rotation, displacement above 1 mm, service above sixty seconds, forbidden contact/intrusion, or resource/time exhaustion.

lineage.reason: Preserves capture relation, incumbent rival, inconclusive comparison, bounded probe, assumptions and uncertain fit.

decision: Candidate probe only if compliant geometry and comparison fit resources. No drilling/cutting/heating/gluing plate or carriage; keep marked 30 mm edge exposed and untouched, avoid stroke clearance, keep carriage on rails. Spare magnet release at 3 N versus 7 N is supplied evidence, not capture validation; feasibility remains uncertain, not deployment.
